## Void Deck 1.2.2

**Two new switches in Quick Access.** **Black and white posters** is the look Void Deck shipped with: covers sit in
gray until you focus them. Turn it off and every cover shows its real colors, on the Home screen and in the Steam
Library alike. **Dot field animation** runs the slow wave and the flickering dots behind the Home hero; turn it off
and the same dot texture stays, still and quiet.

**Both are on by default**, so nothing changes until you touch them. They sit under the Home screen switch and follow
it: with the Home screen off they are disabled, since they only style that screen. **Reset to defaults** turns both
back on, in English or Spanish.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v1.2.2.zip` from this
release. Or press **Update now** in the Void Deck panel.
